skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the fundamental concepts of cloud computing, including cloud services, infrastructure, and security.
Apply parallel programming techniques for cloud computing and large-scale distributed systems.
Explain and utilize the Hadoop framework for distributed data processing.
Design and implement NoSQL databases for cloud storage and retrieval.
Configure and manage high-performance web servers.
Implement security measures for cloud services and infrastructure.
Develop independent problem-solving skills and apply them to cloud computing scenarios.
Work effectively in teams to solve cloud computing problems within deadlines.
Analyze and evaluate cloud computing issues critically.
Demonstrate the ability to independently seek out and utilize cloud computing resources.
Understand and apply ethical principles in cloud computing.
